## Goal
Add the shared value model for normalized judgment artifacts, completion policy, override evidence, finding disposition, and progress signatures.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Contract classes reject missing required fields and invalid disposition values.
- Progress signature is stable for identical inputs and changes when input or artifact fingerprint changes.
- Unit tests cover R1, R3, and R7.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer one deep module under `src/flow/lib/` that owns invariant checks and exposes small named factory/converter functions for existing artifact types.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit tests under `specs/271-flow-judgment-contract/tests/` include `// spec: R1 R3 R7 ...` headers and instantiate contract classes with pass/fail fixtures, invariant errors, and signature stability.
